bullets: On Monday 16 November, Dubai DLD recorded 820 sales worth AED 2.4bn, up 12.8% on a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 65.2% of Monday transactions, compared to a 55.4% average over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,829 per sq ft, which is 9.1% above the 30-day level and down 1.7% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 197 sales, Saih Shuaib 1 with 133 sales, and Dubai Land Residence with 109 sales.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, rising 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Foreign capital inflows are continuing to fuel the expansion of the UAE property sector, driving overseas buyer liquidity and supporting demand.
Dubai housing prices have touched a four-year high amid ongoing value growth, which provides a strong baseline for client advisory and valuation strategies.
Nakheel has introduced the initial villa and townhouse phase at Palm Springs, offering fresh inventory options for high-net-worth buyers and investors.
